description: The finished report. Call it first with failedOnly: true: results, total and nextOffset then cover only the pages that failed, while summary still covers every page. Without it, a slice of every page's result (offset and limit, default 50 a call, at most 5000; nextOffset points at the next slice). The text block is the plain-text report over the slice; includeText: true also puts it in structuredContent.text. limit: 1 returns the summary with one result. Free.

failedOnly.description: Only pages whose status is fail: results, total, nextOffset and text then cover the failed pages alone, while summary still covers every page.

includeText.description: Also return the plain-text report over the slice as structuredContent.text; the text block carries it either way.

jobId.description: The jobId returned when the job was created, e.g. web-1a2b3c.

jobToken.description: The jobToken returned when the job was created. Optional when the request carries the prepaid key that paid the job (Authorization: Bearer dck_…).

limit.description: Page results to return (at most 5000; default 1000 on REST, 50 over MCP).

offset.description: Index of the first page result to return (default 0).
